title: Morgan Wallen, Garth Brooks, Taylor Swift & More Artists With Most Weeks at No. 1 on Top Country Albums Chart: Full List
summary: Male solo artists dominate, though three female solo artists and two groups have also achieved the feat.
body: Morgan Wallen ’s I’m the Problem leads Billboard ‘s Top Country Albums chart (dated Aug. 15) for the 48th nonconsecutive week. This ups Wallen’s career tally of weeks at No. 1 to 234, allowing him to extend his lead as the artist with the most weeks at No. 1 in the chart’s 62-year history. Wallen’s achievement is especially impressive because he has amassed this hefty total of weeks at No. 1 in such a short amount of time. He first topped the chart exactly six years ago — on Aug. 15, 2020. Top Country Albums originated as Hot Country Albums in the Jan. 11, 1964 issue of Billboard . Johnny Cash ’s Ring of Fire (The Best of Johnny Cash) headed the inaugural chart. The compilation was well-timed: “Ring of Fire” had headed Hot Country Songs for seven weeks the previous summer and had crossed over to reach the top 20 on the Billboard Hot 100. The chart was named Hot Country LP’s from 1968 to 1984, when vinyl LPs were king. Twenty-one artists have logged 50 or more weeks at No. 1 on Top Country Albums. body: Ariana Grande earns her seventh No. 1 album on the Billboard 200 chart as petal premieres atop the Aug. 15-dated tally. The set launches with 295,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States in the week ending Aug. 6, marking the singer-songwriter’s biggest week by units in the 2020s. The set also bows with Grande’s biggest week by pure album sales in more than a decade. Taylor Swift leads with 15, followed by Barbra Streisand (11), Madonna (10), Beyoncé (eight) and Janet Jackson, Lady Gaga and Grande (seven each), dating to the chart’s start as a regularly published ranking in 1956. Grande previously led with Eternal Sunshine (No. 1 for three weeks in 2024), Positions (two, 2020), Thank U, Next (two, 2019), Sweetener (one, 2018), My Everything (one, 2014) and Yours Truly (2013). title: لمزاملة لاعب السنغال.. نجم الجزائر مطلوب في الليجا
summary: تحرك نادي فياريال الإسباني، لتعزيز صفوفه بصفقة جزائرية مميزة، خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية الجارية.
body: تحرك نادي فياريال الإسباني، لتعزيز صفوفه بصفقة جزائرية مميزة، خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية الجارية. وذكر موقع " فوت ميركاتو " أن الجزائري هشام بوداوي، نجم نيس الفرنسي، دخل قائمة اهتمامات الفريق الإسباني. وانضم بوداوي، البالغ من العمر 26 عامًا، لصفوف نيس في 2019، وخاض معه 207 مباريات، وسجل 14 هدفًا. وينتهي عقد بوداوي، الذي خاض 37 مباراة دولية مع منتخب الجزائر، مع نيس في صيف 2027. ونوه فوت ميركاتو، أن فياريال تحرك خلال الأيام الأخيرة، للاستفسار عن وضعية بوداوي، ومعرفة إمكانية التعاقد معه هذا الصيف. ويرى فياريال، أن هشام بوداوي يمتلك خصائص مناسبة للفريق، من أجل تشكيل ثنائية مميزة مع السنغالي بابي جاي، في محور خط الوسط. title: Joe Jonas Says He Sought Therapy After His Solo Album Underperformed
summary: Fastlife peaked at No. 15 on the Billboard 200, while its lead single "See No More" reached No. 92 on the Hot 100.
body: Joe Jonas has revealed that the disappointing commercial performance of his 2011 solo debut Fastlife triggered panic attacks and physical pain that ultimately led him to seek therapy. The singer reflected on the album’s reception during a recent episode of the Hey Jonas! podcast, which he co-hosts with his Jonas Brothers bandmates and siblings, Nick and Kevin Jonas. Jonas said he had expected the record to match the success the trio had enjoyed at their peak and had tied its outcome to his own self-worth. “Somewhere in my core, I was like, ‘If I do that, then I matter,'” he told his brothers. Fastlife peaked at No. 15 on the Billboard 200, while its lead single “See No More” reached No. 92 on the Hot 100 — results Jonas found deeply deflating. “I started having panic attacks and started having physical pain,” he recalled. He said a doctor found him physically healthy and recommended he see a therapist, a suggestion he initially resisted. “I was like, what do you mean a therapist? I don’t need a therapist.
